title: Medical Negligence In Infant Circumcision: Malappuram Consumer Commission Awards ₹50 Lakh Compensation
description: The District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Malappuram, comprising President Sri V. Ravindran and Members Smt. R. Bindu and Sri K. Muhammed Ismail, held a doctor and a private hospital liable for medical negligence and deficiency in service.
